description: Fuzzer implementation for testing the SpdySession component in Chromium, involving network socket mocking, SSL data provisioning, and fuzzing the session handling.

classes.name: FuzzerDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for handling SPDY stream events during fuzzing, calls a closure upon stream close.

classes.name: FuzzedSocketFactoryWithMockSSLData
classes.description: Custom socket factory that provides mock SSL data for testing.

methods.name: FuzzerDelegate::OnClose
methods.description: Invokes the stored closure when the stream closes.

methods.name: FuzzedSocketFactoryWithMockSSLData::AddSSLSocketDataProvider
methods.description: Adds an SSL socket data provider to the mock socket factory.

methods.name: FuzzedSocketFactoryWithMockSSLData::CreateSSLClientSocket
methods.description: Creates a mock SSL client socket using provided SSL data.
